opportunities.name: Ryanair flight search
opportunities.description: Search Ryanair for flights from {origin} to {destination} on {depart_date}/{return_date}, then select fares (and optionally apply a promo code).
steps: Click the From field and pick the origin airport (by country list or by typing)
Click the To field and pick the destination country, then the airport
Open the date picker, go to the month, and click the departure date
Click Select on the outbound and return flights
Optionally pick a fare, open Apply promo code, type the code and search again

instances.values: Dublin -> Malta; date 22, then date changed to 5; outbound and return flights selected
Tel Aviv / Dublin / Paris Beauvais -> Venice Treviso; May 9–16; promo code 1000001

opportunities.name: Booking.com attraction search
opportunities.description: On Booking.com Attractions, search for {destination/attraction}, pick {date}, and open a result to check availability.
steps: Type or browse to the destination/attraction (e.g., by region) and select it
Click Select your dates and tick the date
Click Search / apply filters or sort
Open the attraction and click See availability / pick options

instances.values: Asia > Kyoto, 25 May 2023, sorted by Most popular, checked availability
